name: Plinth
summary: A brutalist architecture studio page with six tilted 3D cards that turn as you drag or swipe
about: A concrete-and-orange gallery page for an architecture or photo studio. Six drawn building photographs sit on a 3D coverflow ring that turns with your drag, flicks with inertia and springs onto the nearest card while the caption changes letter by letter. Below are a filterable project index with a floating preview, count-up stats, a services accordion and a validated contact form.
how: Grid lines draw down the page, the headline slides up and the six cards fly in from deep space
Drag or swipe the gallery: the cards turn in 3D as they pass, then spring onto the nearest one
Tap a side card, use the arrows, the dots or the arrow keys to jump; hover the front card to tilt it
Filter the project index by type, hover a row to see a preview follow your pointer, and click it to open it in the gallery
Scroll to count up the studio numbers and open a service to see what is included
Fill the contact form: it checks each field, shows a transmit bar and stamps the brief as received
